summary: Made error ProblemDetails explicitly include RFC 7807 type and title fields, including the 410 Gone response for links at their click limit.
rationale: The redirect-limit tests require type and title in the 410 ProblemDetails body. Explicit values avoid relying on framework defaults while preserving the existing status codes and error details.
content: Updated the API exception handler to provide explicit ProblemDetails metadata for validation and link-operation errors.
